concept.title: Consent or permission needed
concept.shortdesc: Needing consent or permission from a parent, guardian, family or other person before using or taking part in a service.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.
